question: Dry Ice is the solid form of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**carbon dioxide**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dry ice is carbon dioxide in its solid form,** a thick, snowlike material that sublimes (passes straight into the vapour without melting) around 78.5 °C (109.3 °F).
 
• It is employed as a **refrigerant, particularly in the transportation of perishable goods **such as meats or ice cream.
 
• Dry ice may be used to **flash-freeze food, carbonated drinks,** and produce ice cream and root beer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When freezers are unavailable, dry ice can be used to** keep frozen items fresh**
 
• Emergency Refrigeration and Power Outages - While the power is out, **use dry ice to keep the refrigerator and/or freezer running.**
